note: Every alert is a plain SQL query over the service's own tables, so it needs no paid log drain or metrics endpoint. A value of null/unknown is shown as unknown, never as zero. Thresholds 0.70 / 0.85 are the quota warning / critical ratios of deploy/profiles/supabase-free.json.

alerts.title: Journal entries received but not applied (pending or quarantined)
alerts.query: SELECT count(*)::float FROM public.sync_inbox WHERE status <> 'applied'
alerts.action: Inspect quarantined entries; a growing backlog means a producer is stuck or sending unsupported schemas.

alerts.title: Seconds since the newest applied journal entry
alerts.query: SELECT coalesce(extract(epoch FROM now() - max(received_at) FILTER (WHERE status = 'applied')), 0)::float FROM public.sync_inbox
alerts.action: The venue is offline, paused, or the project is paused: LAN work continues; reports show the data age.

alerts.title: Cloud-to-venue commands that expired without a venue receipt
alerts.query: SELECT count(*)::float FROM public.relay_command WHERE status = 'pending' AND expires_at < now()
alerts.action: The coordinator did not pull them: check the venue's connection; senders re-send under their own rules.

alerts.title: Jobs that exhausted their attempts
alerts.query: SELECT count(*)::float FROM public.cloud_job WHERE status = 'dead_letter'
alerts.action: A person resolves each one (channel.operate); nothing retries a dead letter by itself.

alerts.title: Jobs whose outcome is unknown (an external call may have happened)
alerts.query: SELECT count(*)::float FROM public.cloud_job WHERE status = 'unknown'
alerts.action: They are reconciled by querying the other side, never repeated blindly.

alerts.title: Payment intents in an unknown state
alerts.query: SELECT count(*)::float FROM public.payment_intent WHERE status = 'unknown'
alerts.action: reconcilePaymentIntents queries the provider; money is never assumed.

alerts.title: Real money held as unapplied (not on a bill)
alerts.query: SELECT count(*)::float FROM public.payment_intent WHERE status = 'unapplied'
alerts.action: A manager applies or refunds each one.

alerts.title: E-invoice requests whose issue outcome is unknown
alerts.query: SELECT count(*)::float FROM public.invoice_request WHERE status = 'unknown'
alerts.action: They are queried with the same request key before any new issue.

alerts.title: External orders waiting for the restaurant
alerts.query: SELECT count(*)::float FROM public.external_order WHERE status = 'received'
alerts.action: Staff accept or reject; unanswered ones expire at their own deadline.

alerts.title: Database size as a share of the Free quota (500 MB)
alerts.action: Archive/export old journal data per docs/operations/access-retention.md; a hosted project must be measured in the Supabase dashboard.
